peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 3.4% below its local comparables; 19 of 44 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (90.2): 6.3 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 46 of 51 similar developments. Context, not scored: resales in 100% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $850,000 ($1,901 psf, 409–484 sq ft; 13 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,863 psf (range $1,746–2,230); 2% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $17,000 more. 2-bedroom: median $1,250,000 ($1,888 psf, 613–699 sq ft; 27 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 6 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,071 psf (range $1,849–2,353); 8.8% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $121,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Aljunied MRT about 370 m, Mattar MRT about 830 m; closer than 10 of 51 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Geylang Methodist School (Primary) about 380 m; more than 24 of 51 similar developments (the same as 23). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 9 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 670 m), more than 41 of 51 similar developments (the same as 3); nearest hawker centre Sims Vista Market And Food Centre about 330 m; nearest park Aljunied Park about 920 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Sims Vista Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 4 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Zyanya, 2 new sales, about 670 m; Grand Dunman, 72 new sales, about 1,680 m; The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 1,880 m; The Arcady at Boon Keng, 32 new sales, about 1,950 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 219 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 314 new sales and 495 resales (809 purchases); new sales were 38.8% of these purchases. Subsales (33) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Kallang Close GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,640 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 495 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 13 of 51 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 495 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 587 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−15.7%). Planning-area private resales −17.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
